settings.sectionDesc: Trusted by esports legends and anyone who demands all-day comfort, these chairs bring professional-grade design to every user.

settings.itemTitle: Cloud like soft comfort — gentle on first touch
settings.itemDesc: The Blacklyte Memory Foam Cushion combines dual-layer precision: a plush memory foam top that contours to your body, paired with a high-density molded foam base for stability. Tuned to a balanced 30 ± 2 hardness, it delivers a soft, cloud-like feel without losing structure—perfectly blending comfort and support from the moment you sit down.

Ergonomic design is as much about the data as it is about how it feels. To determine the perfect levels of softness and support, we analyzed data from advanced pressure mapping tests and extensive user testing to refine our foam composition. This meticulous approach allowed us to create a seat that feels exceptional and effectively reduces strain over long hours.

settings.itemTitle: Material design excellence — clean, safe, and breathable
settings.itemDesc: Infused with carbon and silver ions, the cushion naturally controls odor, resists bacteria, and disperses heat for all-day freshness. Every component meets strict REACH standards, ensuring it’s not only durable but also safe for you and the environment. From core to cover, Blacklyte prioritizes health, hygiene, and long-term comfort.

settings.itemTitle: Designed for Every Shape and Size
settings.itemDesc: Each Blacklyte model offers tailored seat and backrest dimensions, allowing most users to find a chair that supports their body. From casual use to long focused sessions, our ergonomic design ensures comfort and stability for all.

settings.sectionTitle: Choose the Chair That Truly Fits
settings.sectionDescripe: Stop making do with chairs that fall short. Explore how Blacklyte combines thoughtful design, premium materials, and ergonomic engineering to keep you comfortable all day.

settings.itemTitle: 1. Are gaming chairs only for gamers?
settings.itemDesc: No. Gaming chairs are designed for anyone who values comfort, support, and style. Whether you’re a professional working long hours, a student, or simply looking for a stylish and ergonomic chair, gaming chairs provide adjustable features and a durable design to enhance your everyday seating experience.

settings.itemTitle: 2. What makes Blacklyte gaming chairs different from others?
settings.itemDesc: Blacklyte gaming chairs combine ergonomic design, premium materials, and esports-level performance. With high-density foam, sturdy steel frames, and adjustable support, our ergonomic gaming chairs provide lasting comfort for long gaming sessions or office work.

settings.itemTitle: 3. Which Blacklyte gaming chair should I choose?
settings.itemDesc: If you want premium comfort and top-tier ergonomic design, go for Athena Pro. For a balanced combination of performance and value, choose Athena. If you’re on a budget but want reliable support and comfort, Athena X is the right pick. If you prefer a bold design with enhanced lumbar support for long sessions, Kraken delivers the perfect mix of comfort and style. For advanced ergonomics, upgraded materials, and pro-level performance, step up to the Kraken Pro.

settings.itemTitle: 4. Do Blacklyte gaming chairs come with a warranty?
settings.itemDesc: Yes. All Blacklyte gaming chair comes with a standard 3-year warranty. For added protection, you can join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a €10 cashback.

settings.itemTitle: 5. Do Blacklyte gaming chairs come with free shipping?
settings.itemDesc: Yes. All Blacklyte gaming chairs come with free shipping to most countries, so you can enjoy a hassle-free delivery right to your home.

settings.itemTitle: 6. Can I return or exchange my gaming chair?
settings.itemDesc: Of course. We offer a 30-day free return and exchange policy to ensure you’re completely satisfied with your purchase.
